name_zh: 江泽民/中国/三个代表/入世/党的建设/科教兴国/长江三角洲
name_en: Jiang Zemin/China/Three Represents/WTO Entry/Party Building/Science Education/Jiangnan
description_zh: 江泽民 (1926-2022) 中国第三代核心领导人 (1989-2002)，"三个代表" 重要思想写入党章，2001 年中国加入 WTO 融入全球贸易体系，"科教兴国" 战略确立人才强国方向，大力发展长三角一体化奠定中国经济增长极，党的建设推进执政党现代化。
description_en: Jiang Zemin (1926-2022) China third generation core leader (1989-2002), Three Represents important thought written into Party Constitution, 2001 China WTO entry integrated into global trade system, Science and Education strategy established talent-powerful nation direction, vigorously developed Yangtze Delta integration laying China economic growth pole, Party building advanced governing party modernization.
reason_zh: 江泽民代表改革深水区如何通过理论创新与制度开放双轮驱动突围，展示了"三个代表"如何将党的阶级基础从工农联盟扩展至先进生产力/文化/利益代表者，其入世决策以制度成本换取发展空间，长三角一体化重塑中国经济版图。
reason_en: Jiang represents how reform deep-water zone breaks through via theoretical innovation and institutional opening dual-wheel, demonstrating how Three Represents expanded Party class base from worker-peasant alliance to advanced productive forces/culture/interests representatives, his WTO entry decision trading institutional costs for development space, Yangtze Delta integration reshaping China economic map.

expected_en: Master how theoretical innovation escorts reform legitimacy, grasp WTO entry trading institutional costs for development space, evaluate Jiang Three Represents/WTO entry/Yangtze Delta decisive reshaping of China globalization integration and regional economy.
